quranTranslation.text: And to the three also (did He turn in mercy) who were left behind, when the earth, vast as it is, was straitened for them, and their own souls were straitened for them till they bethought them that there is no refuge from Allah save toward Him. Then turned He unto them in mercy that they (too) might turn (repentant unto Him). Lo! Allah! He is the Relenting, the Merciful.

explanation.bs: „…kad im je zemlja, uza svu svoju prostranost, postala tijesna, a tijesne im postale i same duše“ – tijesnoća i tuga.
explanation.en: “…when the earth, vast as it is, was straitened for them, and their own souls were straitened for them” — the constriction of soul and earth, of grief.

quranTranslation.text: And when Our messengers came unto Lot, he was distressed and knew not how to protect them. He said: This is a distressful day.

explanation.bs: Lut se „zbog njih ražalosti i osjeti se nemoćnim pred njima“ – ar-Rāġib: bio je nemoćan pred njima.
explanation.en: Lot “was distressed and knew not how to protect them (وَضَاقَ بِهِمْ ذَرْعًا)” — ar-Rāġib: he was at a loss with them.

quranTranslation.text: And I shall be embarrassed, and my tongue will not speak plainly, therefor send for Aaron (to help me).

explanation.bs: Musa: „I stegnut će mi se grudi, a jezik mi se neće razvezati“ – tjeskoba pred velikim zadatkom.
explanation.en: Moses: “And I shall be embarrassed (وَيَضِيقُ صَدْرِي), and my tongue will not speak plainly” — distress before a great task.

quranTranslation.text: And strive for Allah with the endeavour which is His right. He hath chosen you and hath not laid upon you in religion any hardship; the faith of your father Abraham (is yours). He hath named you Muslims of old time and in this (Scripture), that the messenger may be a witness against you, and that ye may be witnesses against mankind. So establish worship, pay the poor-due, and hold fast to Allah. He is your Protecting friend. A blessed Patron and a blessed Helper!

explanation.bs: „…i nije vam u vjeri nametnuo nikakvu teškoću“ – teškoća koja se nameće.
explanation.en: “…hath not laid upon you in religion any hardship” — a hardship laid upon people.

quranTranslation.text: No blame is there upon the blind nor any blame upon the lame nor any blame upon the sick nor on yourselves if ye eat from your houses, or the houses of your fathers, or the houses of your mothers, or the houses of your brothers, or the houses of your sisters, or the houses of your fathers' brothers, or the houses of your fathers' sisters, or the houses of your mothers' brothers, or the houses of your mothers' sisters, or (from that) whereof ye hold the keys, or (from the house) of a friend. No sin shall it be for you whether ye eat together or apart. But when ye enter houses, salute one another with a greeting from Allah, blessed and sweet. Thus Allah maketh clear His revelations for you, that haply ye may understand.

explanation.bs: „Nema smetnje slijepom…“ – skidanje teškoće; mnogi mufesiri to shvaćaju i kao krivicu.
explanation.en: “No blame is there upon the blind…” — a lifting of hardship; many mufassirun take it as blame too, as rendered here.

quranTranslation.text: But nay, by thy Lord, they will not believe (in truth) until they make thee judge of what is in dispute between them and find within themselves no dislike of that which thou decidest, and submit with full submission.

explanation.bs: „…a potom u dušama svojim ne nađu nikakve tegobe od onoga što si ti presudio“ – tjeskoba u duši.
explanation.en: “…and find within themselves no dislike (حَرَجًا) of that which thou decidest” — tightness within the soul.

quranTranslation.text: But how (will it be with them) when We bring of every people a witness, and We bring thee (O Muhammad) a witness against these?

explanation.bs: „Pa kako će biti kad od svake zajednice dovedemo svjedoka …“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “When We bring of every people a witness” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: Him unto Whom belongeth the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth; and Allah is of all things the Witness.

explanation.bs: „… a Allah je svemu svjedok“ – ništa Mu nije skriveno, kako Njemu priliči.
explanation.en: “And Allah is of all things the Witness” — nothing is hidden from Him, as befits Him.

quranTranslation.text: He uttereth no word but there is with him an observer ready.

explanation.bs: „Ne izgovori on nijednu riječ, a da uz njega nije nadzornik spreman“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “He uttereth no word but there is with him an observer ready” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: I spake unto them only that which Thou commandedst me, (saying): Worship Allah, my Lord and your Lord. I was a witness of them while I dwelt among them, and when Thou tookest me Thou wast the Watcher over them. Thou art Witness over all things.

explanation.bs: „… Dok sam bio kod njih, bio sam njihov svjedok; a kad si me preuzeo, Ti si bio Nadzornik nad njima …“ – Isa razlikuje dvije riječi: svjedok je bio dok je bio prisutan, a Allah je nadzornik nad njima, kako Njemu priliči.
explanation.en: “I was a witness of them while I dwelt among them, and when Thou tookest me Thou wast the Watcher over them” — Jesus sets the two words apart: he was a witness while present, and Allah is the Watcher over them, as befits Him.

quranTranslation.text: That which Allah leaveth with you is better for you if ye are believers; and I am not a keeper over you.

explanation.bs: „… a ja vam nisam čuvar“ – Šuajbove riječi: on dostavlja poruku, a ne odgovara za njihova djela.
explanation.en: “And I am not a keeper over you” — Shuʿayb's words: he conveys the message, he is not answerable for their deeds.

quranTranslation.text: He said: Set me over the storehouses of the land. Lo! I am a skilled custodian.

explanation.bs: „Postavi me nad riznicama zemlje, ja sam čuvar, znalac“ – Jusuf traži da bude postavljen nad riznicama: zna ih čuvati i zna njima upravljati.
explanation.en: Joseph asks to be set over the storehouses of the land, saying that he is a keeper (ḥafīẓ) and knowing (ʿalīm): he can guard them and knows how to manage them.

quranTranslation.text: We know that which the earth taketh of them, and with Us is a recording Book.

explanation.bs: „… a kod Nas je Knjiga koja čuva“ – ar-Rāġib: Knjiga koja čuva njihova djela, ili koja je sama sačuvana, ništa se ne gubi.
explanation.en: “With Us is a recording Book” — ar-Rāġib: a Book that keeps their deeds, or that is itself kept, nothing lost.

quranTranslation.text: Your Allah is One Allah; there is no Allah save Him, the Beneficent, the Merciful.

explanation.bs: „Onaj kome robujete jedno je jedino Božanstvo – drugog božanstva osim Njega nema, Svemilosnog, Milostivog“ – jednoća Boga, kako Njemu priliči.
explanation.en: “Your Allah is One Allah; there is no Allah save Him, the Beneficent, the Merciful” — the oneness of God, as befits Him.

quranTranslation.text: And he said: O my sons! Go not in by one gate; go in by different gates. I can naught avail you as against Allah. Lo! the decision rests with Allah only. In Him do I put my trust, and in Him let all the trusting put their trust.

explanation.bs: „… nemojte ući kroz jedna vrata, već uđite kroz razna vrata …“ – Jakubov savjet sinovima: ista riječ za obična, prebrojiva vrata.
explanation.en: “O my sons! Go not in by one gate; go in by different gates” — Jacob's counsel to his sons: the same word for an ordinary, countable gate.

quranTranslation.text: Say: He is Allah, the One!

explanation.bs: „Kaži: ‚On – Allah je Jedini‘“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet kao mjesto gdje aḥad stoji sam kao opis; kako Njemu priliči.
explanation.en: “Say: He is Allah, the One!” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah as the place where aḥad stands alone as a description; as befits Him.

quranTranslation.text: And not one of you could have held Us off from him.

explanation.bs: „… i niko od vas ne bi Nas od njega mogao odbiti“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet za aḥad u nijekanju, koji obuhvata i više njih.
explanation.en: “And not one of you could have held Us off from him” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah for aḥad in a negation, which covers more than one.
